questions.question: Does any retrieved source report Pwrong at or near the aligned Pgood operating threshold - the residual measurement KN-OPEN-016 names?
questions.finding_under_adjudication: KN-OPEN-016 residual (also KN-FIND-012 / EV-MLKEM-011, KN-FIND-014 / EV-MLKEM-013)
questions.answer: No. No retrieved source reports a MEASURED Pwrong at or near the aligned Pgood ~ 1/2 operating threshold. Modeled Pwrong values at that threshold do exist (Carrier Table C.2, at Kyber parameters); measured ones do not, in any source retrieved here.

retrieved_sources_checked.source: Carrier et al. full text (HAL hal-05406481 v1, ModDate 2025-06-11T13:28:36Z)
retrieved_sources_checked.detail: Fig 4.1 is the paper's experimental validation of Approximation 4.9 for Pwrong; its printed T axis spans the tick range 200..1600 in both panels. The operating threshold is defined elsewhere: 'we select T following Approximation 4.8, ensuring thatPgood ≈ 1 2' (PDF page 27, printed page 26) and 'We recall thatPgood ≈ 0.5' (Table C.2 caption). Table C.2's log2(Pwrong) entries (CC Kyber-512 -119.57, CN Kyber-512 -120.51) are optimizer/model outputs at Kyber parameters, explicitly labelled here as MODELED, not measured.

Three archived Pwrong survival files and one Pgood sample file. For the only parameter set with both (q=241, m=40, n=43, n_fft=8, k_fft=3, n_lat=35, beta_0=32, beta_1=44, avg_N=25971), measured Pwrong has positive mass only up to T=1802 (value 1.786e-11), while the 4000 archived Pgood scores, divided by k_fft=3 to reach the Pwrong scale as EV-MLKEM-013 fixed, run from 2222.56 (min) through 3988.16 (median) to 5940.94 (max). Measured Pwrong therefore stops about 420.6 score units below the smallest aligned Pgood score, and about 2186 units below the aligned median, i.e. below the Pgood ~ 1/2 threshold. The other two Pwrong files reach T=3003 (beta_0=37, avg_N=200001) and T=2309 (n=50, n_lat=42, beta_0=35, beta_1=41, avg_N=25970), but no Pgood file exists at those parameters and the score scale depends on N, so no aligned threshold can be formed for them from archived data.

The term 'Pwrong'/'P_wrong' does not occur; 'false positive' occurs once, in the analytic definition of the correction factor D_fpfn(mu) = (phi_fp(mu)+phi_fn(mu))^2 with phi_fp(mu) = Phi^{-1}(1 - mu/(2*N_enum(s_enum)*p^{k_fft})) (printed pages 20-21), i.e. a Gaussian-tail model term, with no simulated false-positive distribution at the operating threshold.

questions.scope_limits: This is a negative-existence statement over the sources actually retrieved in this task, not over the literature. Two directly relevant full texts were unretrievable. The verdict must not be read as 'nobody has measured this'.
questions.residual_uncertainty: The k_fft alignment convention is taken as frozen from EV-MLKEM-013 and was not re-derived here. The comparison of a survival-function support (Pwrong) with an empirical sample (Pgood) is exactly the comparison EV-MLKEM-011/013 recorded; this task reproduces those statistics from freshly cloned bytes and does not extend them.

reproduction_check.statement: Statistics recomputed from the freshly cloned repository at head reproduce the standing evidence records exactly.
